title: Disable a systemd service from starting on boot
summary: Stop a service from starting automatically when you turn on your computer. This is useful for removing unwanted background processes.

aliases.text: stop service now and disable boot

steps.explain: Disable the service so it no longer starts on boot, and stop it immediately if it is running.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit (e.g., bluetooth, avahi).

steps.expect: No error output. The service should now be inactive and disabled.

rollback.explain: Re-enable the service to start on boot and start it immediately.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit.

warnings: Disabling critical services (like display managers or network managers) can prevent your system from booting correctly or connecting to the internet.
